name: oax-contract
stderr:
Usage: openagentx agent add [--runtime agy|codex] [--name NAME --workspace DIR --role FILE | --identity FILE] [--id ID] [--worker-config FILE] [--environment-file FILE] [--password-file FILE] [--configure-only]
       openagentx agent join --id ID --name NAME --workspace DIR --role FILE [--thread-id ID --endpoint URL] [--handoff-file FILE] [--prepare]
       openagentx agent <open|pause|resume|status> [AGENT] [--console|--native] [--no-open] [--watch] [--json] [--web-url URL]
       Path overrides: --db --socket --file (Fleet manifest) --worker-dir --credentials

自初始化（当前 CLI 可直接执行，无需人工粘贴终端输入）：
  先确认用户授权的职责和工作目录；只记录已知的 thread ID，不猜测 live 绑定。
  openagentx agent join --id research --name Research --workspace "$PWD" --role ./ROLE.md --handoff-file ./HANDOFF.md --prepare
  openagentx agent join --id research --name Research --workspace "$PWD" --role ./ROLE.md --thread-id <known-thread-id> --endpoint <managed-endpoint> --prepare
  当前轮结束后，由用户运行 openagentx agent resume research。

join 默认仅离线准备（--prepare=true）：记录本地身份、角色、目录、交接、私密环境和 receipt。
不启动 Worker 或服务，不领取任务，不宣称原 CLI 已绑定或 ready；重复相同输入幂等，冲突拒绝。
不要让当前 CLI 调用 resume 来接管自己；也不要通过模型反复 poll 维持监听。
角色由 Runtime adapter 注入；宿主负责总线监听。原生入口：openagentx agent open research --native。
--prepare=false 只适用于原 CLI 已结束且明确授权注册/启动的场景。
  -configure-only
    	Register/configure without starting Worker
  -console
    	Open terminal Console
  -credentials value
    	Credential store
  -db value
    	Database path
  -endpoint string
    	Managed Codex app-server endpoint
  -environment-file string
    	Existing private Worker environment file to import
  -file value
    	Fleet manifest
  -handoff-file string
    	Existing Markdown handoff to snapshot privately
  -id string
    	Stable Agent ID (default derived from name)
  -identity string
    	Existing identity YAML to import
  -json
    	Full diagnostic JSON instead of concise navigation
  -model string
    	Runtime model
  -name string
    	Display name
  -native
    	Open managed native terminal through the OAX arbitration bridge
  -no-open
    	Print status without opening UI
  -organization-id string
    	Organization ID (default "default")
  -owner-username string
    	Owner username (default "owner")
  -password-file string
    	Private password file; content is never printed
  -prepare
    	Prepare locally only; do not start or dispatch (join default) (default true)
  -role string
    	Role Markdown file
  -role-text string
    	Role text to save as Markdown
  -runtime string
    	Runtime: agy or codex (default "codex")
  -runtime-binary string
    	Runtime executable (agy-graft or codex by runtime)
  -socket value
    	Daemon socket
  -thread-id string
    	Explicit existing Codex thread ID; never inferred
  -timeout duration
    	Per-run timeout (default 30m0s)
  -wait duration
    	Startup/network readiness deadline (default 3m0s)
  -watch
    	Refresh read-only status every five seconds
  -web-url string
    	Web origin (otherwise discover from user service)
  -worker-config string
    	Existing Worker YAML to import
  -worker-dir value
    	Worker config directory
  -workspace string
    	Working directory
